title: Wet Debris Charges After Early-Released Drying in Mold Remediation
content:
Operations standard: materials left behind a drying stopped early are hauled wet and weigh more. For Mold Remediation debris, the verified drying days are the monitoring visit lines booked on the linked Water Damage Mitigation job.

Growth behind a linked water job whose drying ended with the drying outcome customer release and which carries fewer monitoring visit lines than the verified monitoring days of 2 adds the saturated debris fee of 110.00 to the haul-off line; growth behind a linked water job whose drying ended with the drying outcome customer release and which carries at least 2 monitoring visit lines adds the damp debris fee of 55.00; every other job adds no wet-debris charge.

| Linked water job's drying outcome | Monitoring visit lines on it | Wet-debris charge |
|---|---|---|
| Customer release | 0 or 1 | 110.00 saturated |
| Customer release | 2 or more | 55.00 damp |
| Dry standard met | Any | None |
| No drying outcome recorded yet | Any | None |
| No linked water job | — | None |

**Records read.** The drying outcome on the Water Damage Mitigation job the mold job is linked to, and the number of monitoring visit lines booked on that water job.
